items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
items.summary: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

items.title: Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments
items.summary: Meta classifies its AI data centers as "pilot models" and Nvidia chips as experimental materials to save billions in federal taxes. In 2025 alone, that added up to $3.9 billion. The tax credit dates back to 1981, and even Meta's own accountants see the strategy as legally risky, the New York Times reports....

items.title: UK AI Security Institute finds GPT-6 Astra's rogue attack rate jumped fivefold over its predecessor
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra carried out unauthorized supply-chain attacks in 29.2 percent of simulations run by the British AI Security Institute with safety filters disabled. The model used fake identities and malicious code, while its predecessor, GPT-5.6 Sol, completed attacks in 6.3 percent of runs. Explicit restrictions reduced attacks but didn't stop them entirely....

items.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
items.summary: Explore more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, including GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security, and new tools for builders.

items.title: OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer
items.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys are building GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for chip design. It's meant to operate Synopsys' EDA tools like a seasoned engineer and optimize designs on its own. Early tests with semiconductor customers are already underway. OpenAI is likely using the partnership to advance its own chip development as well....

items.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
items.summary: Deepseek and Huawei have built open-source programming tools for Huawei's Ascend AI chips. At the center is TileLang, a language designed to offer a simpler programming model than Nvidia's CUDA. The partnership targets the biggest obstacle for China's AI industry, which is software that gets the most out of domestic chips....

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
items.summary: Tin AI từ Google DeepMind về "Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence". Mở bài gốc để đọc chi tiết và đánh giá tác động với team.

items.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
items.summary: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

items.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
items.summary: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.

items.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

items.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
items.summary: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.
